numinance.kinds.v1.EnvironmentBudget.jso.description: EnvironmentBudget bounds the environments of one provider.

max_concurrent.description: max_concurrent is the most environments alive at once; absent means 1. A Create above it waits or escalates.

numinance.kinds.v1.EnvironmentBudget.jso.title: Environment Budget

numinance.kinds.v1.EnvironmentProviderSp.description: EnvironmentProviderSpec says which provider creates the environment, from what, and for how long.

budget.description: budget bounds what the provider may hold at once.

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of an environment port provider, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

seed.description: seed names the seed data sets the provider applies after creation; a name is never executed as a command.

source.description: source names what is cloned (a database, a namespace template); the provider resolves the name and it never carries a credential.

tags.description: tags are set on every environment besides the change_id tag; the profile context refuses a change_id key.

ttl.description: ttl is required: the environment is destroyed when it expires; the profile context refuses a ttl that is not positive.

numinance.kinds.v1.EnvironmentProviderSp.title: Environment Provider Spec
